Generate Simulated Panel Survey Data

generate_psurvey_data.Rd

A longitudinal dataset with explanatory variable age and dependent variables income (numeric), ntrips (count) and satisfaction (ordinal) is created. This function also allows to re-create the dataset psurvey included in the package.

Usage

generate_psurvey_data(n)

Arguments

n

number of sample units.

Details

The example below shows how the dataset psurvey included in the package has been generated.

Value

A list containing:

data

a data frame with covariates, random effects, predictors and sampled outcomes,

sd_num

a vector of length three containing the true values of the standard deviations for the numeric covariate,

beta_num

a list of true values (named vector) of \(\beta\) parameters for numeric outcome for each cluster,

beta_poi

a list of true values (named vector) of \(\beta\) parameters for count outcome for each cluster,

beta_ord

a list of true values (named vector) of \(\beta\) parameters for ordinal outcome for each cluster,

c_ord

a list of true values of intercepts specific to each level of the ordinal outcome for each cluster.

Author

Implemented by Jan Vávra to demonstrate the use of the package on artificial data in a vignette.

Examples

### Generate psurvey data
set.seed(31415)
n <- 500
ldata <- generate_psurvey_data(n)
psurvey1 <- ldata$data[,c("i", "j", "age", "income", "ntrips", "satisfaction")]
psurvey_latent1 <- ldata$data[,c("i", "j", "g", "b_num", "b_poi", "b_ord")]

data("psurvey", package = "clustGLMM")
data("psurvey_latent", package = "clustGLMM")
all.equal(psurvey, psurvey1)
#> [1] TRUE
all.equal(psurvey_latent, psurvey_latent1)
#> [1] TRUE
